resources.string: SafeMobile calculates SHA-256 and MD5 hashes on this device and checks them against definitions stored locally. Local scans do not upload files or hashes. Ads use Google Mobile Ads network services only when permitted by your privacy choices and connectivity. Core scan functions work without a network. Installed-app visibility and all-files access are sensitive Android permissions and may require Google Play review.
Checks readable installed APKs against locally stored definitions and reviews files you select. Detection is limited by operating-system access and the definitions installed on this device.
Scan a selected APK or file
Optional monitoring of the public Downloads folder. Android 11+ requires the user to grant all-files access in Settings; Google Play approval is not guaranteed.
Monitoring is opt-in and can be stopped by the user.
%1$d threat matches · %2$d flagged for review · %3$d with no local match
A clean result means there was no match in the local definitions currently installed. This is not a guarantee that a file is safe.
No match was found in the local threat definitions.
No known hash match was found; review these capabilities manually.
Hash is present in the local allowlist.
APK path is not readable; no hash verdict is available.
The file is not readable by this app.
The file could not be read.
Android could not open the selected file.
Certificate subject resembles the Android debug certificate.
Scan completed. A local no-match result is not a guarantee that a file is safe.
Core scanning stays on this device. When connected, you can optionally support independent app development with a coffee contribution.
Offline definitions currently contain only the EICAR antivirus test signature; this does not protect against real-world malware. Import a curated, licensed local signature database.
An app update is available in Google Play.
Update downloaded. Restart the app to finish updating.
Notifications for user-enabled local APK checks.
Watching Downloads for newly written APK files.
For privacy, this scanner only opens files from recognized on-device storage providers. Cloud or third-party document providers are not opened.

A private copy will be saved inside this app. After verifying its hash, SafeMobile will try to remove the selected original. Removal depends on Android storage permissions and the provider; the original may remain.
Quarantine copy saved privately (%1$s); Android reported that the original was removed.
Quarantine copy saved privately (%1$s), but Android would not remove the original. Delete it manually if needed.
Quarantine failed. The original file was not intentionally removed.
Imported %1$d valid signature definitions into local storage.
Definition file could not be imported. Check the JSON format and SHA-256 values.
Scan cancelled. No complete-device safety conclusion was made.
Downloads monitoring could not be started. Check permissions and try again.

SafeMobile validates the JSON structure and hash format, but this local file is not cryptographically authenticated by SafeMobile. Untrusted definitions may create false positives. Import only from a source you trust and are permitted to use. The file and hashes are not uploaded.
The support page could not be opened. Check your connection or try again later.
Review isolated private copies here. Restoring writes a copy to a destination you choose and keeps the quarantined original until you delete it.
Showing the 30 most recent quarantined files.
Restoring writes the file to a location you select. The restored file may be dangerous. Continue only if you trust the file or need it for controlled analysis. The quarantined copy will remain here.
This action permanently deletes the private quarantined copy from SafeMobile. It cannot be undone.
A copy of %1$s was written to the selected destination (%2$d bytes). The quarantined original remains stored.
The quarantined file could not be restored. Check the destination and available storage, then try again.
The quarantined file could not be deleted.
Combines SMS permissions with network access; this is a risk indicator, not proof of malicious behavior.
Combines SMS permissions with an accessibility service declaration; this is a review signal, not proof of OTP interception or malware.
Limited protection — EICAR test definition only
